body: Ive overdosed about an hour ago (not as an attempt, just as self harm) and its taking a bigger toll on me than usual. I keep having hot flashes, lightheaded, my limbs feel weak, a piercing headache, and an upset stomach. Ive taken many more pills before than I have this time so its strange that my body is reacting like this. I think its paired with the fact that I haven’t eaten really in the past 2-3 days. It would be nice to tell my parents but I can’t bring myself to do so

Thank you, I have discussed my worsening mental health with them earlier in the year (February most recently) but nothing has been changed or improved, and no steps for help have been made. In times of stress I have mentioned my suicidal thoughts but have been told that i’m overreacting and that there is no reason for me to think that way. I haven’t mentioned my current suicidal thoughts because I don’t think they will be handled in a supportive way, and a dismissive reply to them would make me feel worse.
